Goal: apply the re-balanced smart-bomb schedules through the single shared catalogue and effect path so the game and every gym run identical code (parent AH-0MV8GPGBL009M0D8, gym-game parity AH-0MUGZDTFX004RBD1).

Update POWER_UP_LEVEL_SPECS.smart_bomb (aoeRadius linear-clamped 200->400 px; interval/frequency schedule max(10, 30-2*level); smartBombDamage unchanged 1->3) and effects.ts smartBombInterval()/smartBombAoe() plus comments. Add a named constant for the 10x SHIP_SIZE base (200 px) and +2 %/level tuning in src/core/constants.ts. The shared seam (CombatCoreScene._updateSmartBomb / CombatScene.onSmartBombPulse / AoEDescriptor) is expected to need no change. Keep smartBombFrequency non-decreasing and summarisePowerUpLevelChange sensible for the interval axis.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `smartBombInterval()` returns max(10, 30 - 2*level) s: 30 s at level 0, 28 s at level 1, 10 s at and beyond level 10; `smartBombFrequency()` stays non-decreasing (monotonicity contract).
- `smartBombAoe().radius` resolves to min(400, 200 * (1 + 0.02 * level)) px for BOTH permanent pulses and one-shot field pickups (cap 2x base).
- `smartBombDamage` spec and behaviour unchanged (1 -> 3 HP).
- No stale 1200/2400 px or 0.2->0.5 /s commentary remains in powerUpLevels.ts rationale or effects.ts comments; constants.txt tuning knobs added.
- `summarisePowerUpLevelChange` / hold-full overlay shows a sensible interval delta (label/unit for seconds).

**Key Files:**
- `src/powerups/powerUpLevels.ts`
- `src/powerups/effects.ts`
- `src/core/constants.ts`
- `src/powerups/powerUpLevels.test.ts`
- `src/powerups/effects.test.ts`

## Parent AC coverage (coverage-review anchor)

- Parent AC coverage — interval: A permanent smart bomb pulses on the interval `max(10, 30 − 2×level)` seconds: 30 s at level 0 (first grant), 28 s at level 1, … 10 s at level 10 and beyond; `smartBombInterval()` reflects this schedule.
- Parent AC coverage — radius: The smart bomb pulse radius resolves to `min(400, 200 × (1 + 0.02 × level))` px: 200 px base (10× ship size), additive +2 % of base per level, capped at 400 px. Applies to both permanent pulses and one-shot field pickups.
- Parent AC coverage — damage: Smart bomb damage per pulse is unchanged (1 → 3 HP across levels).
data.title: Re-spec smart bomb level variables and shared effect path

data.description: The Mystery UFO has no visual representation. Change it so that the main player ship spawns a small version of itself which, colects up to 10 mineral depostis and then flies quickly to the players ship. When it arrives at the players ship it disappears and all collected minerals transfer to the player. It lives for a maximum of 5 seconds at Lvl 0, collecting up to 10 minerals and has a mineral collector that starts at 20 px radius. Each of these properties can increase as the UFO is upgrades. When permanently applied from a full-hull a ship will, initially, spawn every 30 seconds, decreasing on each level. If the UFO is hit by a bullet or an enemy it is destroyed leaving all the minerals + a bonus of 2 * level, for the player to easily collect.

# Docs: document baseline, precedence, and refresh workflow

**Priority:** high · **Issue type:** docs · **Parent:** AH-0MV9GZD2C005IIU3

## Summary
Document the shipped bot-tuning baseline: the precedence rule (`localStorage` → bundled baseline) and the refresh workflow (tune → Export → overwrite `src/data/bot-tuning.json` → commit) so distributed builds and fresh machines fly the correct Bot definitions.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1 — Precedence documented.** The precedence rule (`localStorage` → bundled baseline) is documented in the relevant docs.
- **AC2 — Refresh workflow documented.** The round-trip workflow (tune → Export → overwrite `src/data/bot-tuning.json` → commit → build → fresh browser) is documented, satisfying parent AC4 (byte-equivalent to gym Export output via `serialiseBotTuningState()`).
- **AC3 — Docs updated.** All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries: `docs/dev/gameplay-capture.md` (§ Bot-tuning configuration), `docs/dev/recording-and-replay.md`, and `docs/BOT_FRAMEWORK.md` (§12). Covers parent AC7.
- **AC4 — Code comments.** Relevant code comments in `src/core/botTuningStore.ts` and `src/core/bundledConfig.ts` explain the baseline and why it exists (distribution gap).
- **AC5 — Stale-baseline mitigation noted.** The risk of a stale committed baseline and the mitigation (documented refresh workflow, single source of shipped baseline like the CSVs) is reflected.

## Dependencies (prereqs)
- `Implement: bundle and seed baseline from bundled config` — docs reflect the implemented behaviour.

## Deliverables
- Updated docs listed in AC3/AC4
- Commit referencing parent: `AH-0MV9GZD2C005IIU3`

## Key Files
- `docs/dev/gameplay-capture.md` — § Bot-tuning configuration
- `docs/dev/recording-and-replay.md`
- `docs/BOT_FRAMEWORK.md` — §12
- `README.md` — if it references bot tuning behaviour
- `src/core/botTuningStore.ts` / `src/core/bundledConfig.ts` — code comments

# Validate: typecheck, build, full suite, parity guard

**Priority:** critical · **Issue type:** task · **Parent:** AH-0MV9GZD2C005IIU3

## Summary
Final verification that all parent acceptance criteria for the distributed bot-tuning baseline are satisfied: typecheck, production build, the full project test suite, and the gym↔game duplicate-body parity guard stay green.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1 — Typecheck passes.** `npm run typecheck` passes with the new changes.
- **AC2 — Build passes.** `npm run build` (dev and production) passes and the bundled baseline is included in the output.
- **AC8 — Full project test suite passes.** The full project test suite must pass with the new changes (via the test skill `/skill:test`); any failures are triaged into critical `test-failure` work items. Covers parent AC8.
- **AC4 — Parity guard green.** The repo-wide duplicate-body guard in `src/scenes/core/CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts` and the gym-parity docs assertion stay green; combined with AC1–AC3 this satisfies parent AC6 (unit and integration tests cover fallback and precedence; `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass; parity guard green).
- **AC5 — All parent ACs covered.** Parent AC1–AC8 are each traceable to a child item's acceptance criteria and verified.

## Dependencies (prereqs)
- `Implement: bundle and seed baseline from bundled config`
- `Test: demo-mode integration flies bundled baseline`
- `Docs: document baseline, precedence, and refresh workflow`

## Deliverables
- Recorded typecheck/build/test/parity results as a work-item comment
- Commit referencing parent: `AH-0MV9GZD2C005IIU3`

## Key Files
- `package.json` — typecheck/build/test scripts
- `src/scenes/core/CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts` — parity guard
- `src/data/bot-tuning.json` — bundled baseline verified in build output

Implementation + design decisions (WIP commit dd36932b):

- Catalogue re-spec (src/powerups/powerUpLevels.ts): aoeRadius -> linear-clamped base 200 (10 × SHIP_SIZE) cap 400 k=4 (+2 % of base per level, cap 2× base); smartBombDamage unchanged (1 → 3, exponential-saturation); smartBombFrequency variable renamed smartBombInterval -> linear-clamped base 30 cap 10 k=-2 (descending, whole seconds). The resolver derives smartBombFrequency = 1/smartBombInterval so the rate axis stays monotonic non-decreasing (model contract) while the interval descends.
- Tuning knobs added in src/core/constants.ts (SMART_BOMB_RADIUS_SHIP_MULTIPLIER/RADIUS_PER_LEVEL/RADIUS_CAP_MULTIPLIER + INTERVAL_BASE/PER_LEVEL/FLOOR seconds) and consumed by the specs.
- effects.ts reads the stored interval directly in smartBombInterval() (max(10, 30−2L)) and derives smartBombFrequency() = 1/interval; smartBombAoe fallback 1200→200; screen-wide comments corrected.
- Shared seam changed: none (CombatCoreScene._updateSmartBomb / CombatScene.onSmartBombPulse / AoEDescriptor untouched).
- Handoff from AH-0MV98DVM90015DNF: removed the .fails wrappers (all 4 RED tests) - now green.
- Docs guard (powerUpLevelingDocs.test.ts) requires every spec label in the GDD; added 'Pulse interval' + corrected the three stale smart-bomb level-variable lists in docs/Game Design Document.md (200→400 px, 30→10 s, ship-centred text). The full docs sweep (research doc §6, README) remains C4's scope (AH-0MV98DYAD0016L37).
- Verified: tsc typecheck clean, full vitest suite green (5462 tests, 0 failures).
